newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-BOURSE CLOSE: INDEX GAINS, HANSA MOST ACTIVE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-BOURSE CLOSE: INDEX GAINS, HANSA MOST ACTIVE.

text.p: * Preliminary closing data from the Tallinn stock exchange
put total trade on the Estonian bourse at 46.2 million kroons
* The Talse online index gained 0.95 percent to close at
264.11. (See index on stock exchange web site:
* Preliminary data showed that Hansapank was most
traded with turnover of 23.1 million kroons to close 0.59 kroons
* On the free market, Norma was most actively
traded with turnover of 3.3 million kroons to close 1.1 kroons
